starting-off.speaker: Cassius
starting-off.text: That depends. Do you like making money?

starting-off.player: I'm not averse to making money.

starting-off.text: If the player is on a quest speedrunning world:

steps.player: I suppose it's okay.

steps.speaker: Cassius
steps.text: Well, fair enough. If your passion for milk changes, let me know.
This quest is not available on Speedrunning Worlds.

starting-off.player: I can't say I've thought much about it.

starting-off.speaker: Cassius
starting-off.text: Would you like to think more about it?
Before starting this quest, be aware that your combat level is lower than the recommended level of 15.

starting-off.prompt: Start The Ides of Milk quest?

steps.player: What am I going to get from thinking more about... milk?

steps.speaker: Cassius
steps.text: Profit!

steps.speaker: Cassius
steps.text: Ten to fifteen percent, performance depending.

steps.player: How are we going to be making that profit? And who even are you anyway?

steps.speaker: Cassius
steps.text: Ah, my name is Cassius. I got carried away.

steps.speaker: Cassius
steps.text: But, we're going to construct an empire.

steps.player: Of milk?

steps.speaker: Cassius
steps.text: Of milk.

steps.player: How do you intend to make an empire of milk?

steps.speaker: Cassius
steps.text: So, the first step is going to involve you doing a little... research.

steps.player: Right...

steps.speaker: Cassius
steps.text: You're going to cross the River Lum, find Gillie and Seth Groats, and learn about animal husbandry.

steps.speaker: Cassius
steps.text: Then... Then you're going to cross back to this side of the river, and tell me all about how they've made their animals so productive.

steps.speaker: Cassius
steps.text: It's a perfect plan!

steps.player: What use is it if I know everything and you don't? Couldn't I make my own... milk empire... with that information?
If anything I should be cutting you in at ten to fifteen percent.

steps.speaker: Cassius
steps.text: Hey, I'm the one supplying the high-quality milk here.

steps.speaker: Cassius
steps.text: Not to mention, my associate Brutus is already embedded in the Groats operation to work a different angle. That will prove most lucrative.

steps.player: Right... I guess I'll go and see the Groatses then.
No, I'm not sure I would like that, thank you.

starting-off-attempting-to-release-the-b.player: Releasing the bull into the cow pen is a bad idea.

starting-off-attempting-to-release-the-b.text: You need to have completed The Ides of Milk quest to release this bull.

starting-off-talking-to-cassius-again-be.player: What was it you needed me to do again?

starting-off-talking-to-cassius-again-be.speaker: Cassius
starting-off-talking-to-cassius-again-be.text: I need you to speak to Gillie and Seth Groats. We need to learn everything we can.

starting-off-talking-to-cassius-again-be.speaker: Cassius
starting-off-talking-to-cassius-again-be.text: They live just across the River Lum. Head east from here and you should be able to find them.

starting-off-talking-to-gillie.speaker: Gillie Groats
starting-off-talking-to-gillie.text: Hello, I'm Gillie the Milkmaid. What can I do for you?

options.text: Can you tell me how to milk a cow?
Can you share what makes your cows so productive?

steps.player: Can you share what makes your cows so productive?

steps.speaker: Gillie Groats
steps.text: Absolutely! The secret is happiness.

steps.player: Happiness?

steps.speaker: Gillie Groats
steps.text: The cows make the best milk when they're happy, and to be honest, they make too much!

steps.speaker: Gillie Groats
steps.text: I'm always glad that adventurers come by and help with milking them. I wouldn't be able to keep up otherwise.

steps.player: That can't be everything though, can it?

steps.speaker: Gillie Groats
steps.text: Come to think of it, I'm sure my father keeps a few tricks up his sleeve. Why don't you go and ask him?
If the player has not yet talked to Seth Groats:

steps.player: That would be Seth, wouldn't it?

steps.speaker: Gillie Groats
steps.text: It would be! I'm sure he'll he happy to share some information with you.

steps.player: I'll go and speak to him now, thank you!

steps.text: If the player has already talked to Seth Groats:

steps.player: I've already had a chance to talk to him. He did indeed have some tricks to share!

steps.speaker: Gillie Groats
steps.text: That's good. You must be ready to care for your own cows at this point!

steps.player: If you think so, then I must be. Thank you for your help, I'll make sure that knowledge is put to good use.

starting-off-talking-to-seth.speaker: Seth Groats
starting-off-talking-to-seth.text: Well well, what can I do for you?

starting-off-talking-to-seth.player: I was wondering if you could teach me a little about how you're so successful with your animals.

starting-off-talking-to-seth.speaker: Seth Groats
starting-off-talking-to-seth.text: Lookin' to get into the business, eh?

starting-off-talking-to-seth.speaker: Seth Groats
starting-off-talking-to-seth.text: Well, always happy to help another budding farmer out!

starting-off-talking-to-seth.player: Great! So where do I start?

starting-off-talking-to-seth.speaker: Seth Groats
starting-off-talking-to-seth.text: Would always recommend me Groats Principles as yer basics.

starting-off-talking-to-seth.speaker: Seth Groats
starting-off-talking-to-seth.text: Aye. First one is that happy animals makes happy farmers.

starting-off-talking-to-seth.speaker: Seth Groats
starting-off-talking-to-seth.text: Second of me principles is to never take more than you need. Greed'll stop you in your tracks.

starting-off-talking-to-seth.speaker: Seth Groats
starting-off-talking-to-seth.text: The last principle: never let the taxman know yer earnings. Money should be spent on the animals!
If the player is an ironman:

steps.player: I don't think I've ever paid any taxes.

steps.speaker: Seth Groats
steps.text: You're ahead of the game then!

starting-off-talking-to-seth.text: If the player is not an ironman:

steps.player: You've found a way to get around the taxes?

steps.speaker: Seth Groats
steps.text: A way or two.

starting-off-talking-to-seth.speaker: Seth Groats
starting-off-talking-to-seth.text: Anyway, feel free to grab me book on the topic from the shelf over there.

starting-off-talking-to-seth.player: Okay, thank you for the help.

starting-off-searching-the-shelf.text: Before learning about the book or while having the book already:

steps.text: You find a bucket on the shelf, as you'd expect a farmer to have.
You find a loose egg on the shelf, and fortunately avoid knocking it to the floor.
Hidden behind the piles of junk on the shelf, you find a small farmer's hat with Gillie's name written on it.
You find Seth's book on the shelf, but don't have room to take it with you.
You find Seth's book of principles on the shelf.

starting-off-talking-to-seth-again.speaker: Seth Groats
starting-off-talking-to-seth-again.text: Well well, what can I do for you?

starting-off-talking-to-seth-again.player: I was wondering if you could teach me a little about how you're so successful with your animals.

starting-off-talking-to-seth-again.speaker: Seth Groats
starting-off-talking-to-seth-again.text: Mmm we already had this talk. Go read me book on the shelf over there.
If the player doesn't have the book on them:

steps.player: I'll go grab it, thanks.

starting-off-talking-to-seth-again.text: If the player has the book on them:

steps.player: I've actually got it here, I'll take it away and give it a read somewhere a little more peaceful.

returning-to-cassius.speaker: Cassius
returning-to-cassius.text: So, how did you get on?

returning-to-cassius.player: I've learned a lot about how the Groats family care for their animals. They say the secret is happiness!

returning-to-cassius.speaker: Cassius
returning-to-cassius.text: Happiness?! That can't be the only trick they use! Surely you found something else?
If the player doesn't have the book on them:

steps.player: Now that you mention it, Seth did say he had a book that I... don't have on me right now.

steps.speaker: Cassius
steps.text: The legendary Groats book on milk cultivation? I'm most interested! Go fetch it!

returning-to-cassius.player: I have this book from Seth. He claims it's got his principles of animal husbandry in it, if that's of any use?

returning-to-cassius.text: Cassius snatches the book from your hands.

returning-to-cassius.speaker: Cassius
returning-to-cassius.text: The idea that a happy animal will do what you want is frankly absurd. What if they choose to not produce. Are you supposed to respect that?

returning-to-cassius.speaker: Cassius
returning-to-cassius.text: However, the writings on the systems of taxation are fascinating. I couldn't imagine Seth was smart enough to put this together.

returning-to-cassius.player: So, do you think this is enough to start our milk empire?

returning-to-cassius.speaker: Cassius
returning-to-cassius.text: No, no. Not quite yet. First of all, you haven't tried our milk yet, have you?

returning-to-cassius.player: I don't think I have, no. You already have some milk?

returning-to-cassius.speaker: Cassius
returning-to-cassius.text: Don't look so worried. Here, have a try.
Cassius hands you a milk sample to try.

returning-to-cassius-destroying-the-milk.text: Why would you want to destroy such good milk? Do you not wish to taste it?

returning-to-cassius-reclaiming-the-milk.player: I've managed to lose that sample of milk...

steps.speaker: Cassius
steps.text: I'll give you some more once you've got some space.
Cassius glares as he hands you another sample of milk.

returning-to-cassius-talking-to-cassius-.speaker: Cassius
returning-to-cassius-talking-to-cassius-.text: Have you given that sample a try yet?

returning-to-cassius-after-sampling-the-.text: The player coughs and is damaged for 1 Hitpoints with a poison hitsplat.

returning-to-cassius-after-sampling-the-.speaker: Cassius
returning-to-cassius-after-sampling-the-.text: So, what do you think? The milk is fantastic, isn't it?

returning-to-cassius-after-sampling-the-.player: It wasn't what I was expecting, certainly.

returning-to-cassius-after-sampling-the-.speaker: Cassius
returning-to-cassius-after-sampling-the-.text: We're going to change the lactic landscape! Before we do though, I have another task for you.

returning-to-cassius-after-sampling-the-.player: Shouldn't you have got a permit before making milk?

returning-to-cassius-after-sampling-the-.speaker: Cassius
returning-to-cassius-after-sampling-the-.text: The permit is to sell milk, not to make milk!

returning-to-cassius-after-sampling-the-.player: Fine, where are we going to get this permit?

returning-to-cassius-after-sampling-the-.speaker: Cassius
returning-to-cassius-after-sampling-the-.text: From the Duke of Lumbridge! Where else? You need to bring him our milk and I'm sure he'll give us our permit without fuss.

returning-to-cassius-after-sampling-the-.player: Are you sure having the Duke drink our milk is a good idea?

returning-to-cassius-after-sampling-the-.speaker: Cassius
returning-to-cassius-after-sampling-the-.text: Of course! Soon the whole of Lumbridge will be drinking my, I mean our milk!
Cassius hands you a milk sample.

returning-to-cassius-attempting-to-drink.player: I don't think I'm ready to drink another vial of this stuff.
I should find someone else to give it to.

returning-to-cassius-talking-to-cassius-.speaker: Cassius
returning-to-cassius-talking-to-cassius-.text: Has the Duke given us our permit yet?
If the player lost the second milk sample:

steps.player: Not yet, no. I could do with another sample of milk though, if you have one spare?

steps.speaker: Cassius
steps.text: I should have one somewhere here. Just a moment.
Without free inventory space:

steps.speaker: Cassius
steps.text: It looks like you don't have space to carry this. You'll have to grab it from me when you have room.
With free inventory space:

steps.speaker: Cassius
steps.text: I should have one somewhere here. Just a moment.
Cassius hands you a milk sample.

returning-to-cassius-talking-to-cassius-.text: If the player still has the second milk sample:

steps.player: Not yet, no, but I am working on it!

talking-to-the-duke.player: Greetings. I come seeking a business permit.

talking-to-the-duke.speaker: Duke Horacio
talking-to-the-duke.text: Oh wonderful! What sort of business are you looking to start?

talking-to-the-duke.player: I'm looking to get into the milk trade!

talking-to-the-duke.speaker: Duke Horacio
talking-to-the-duke.text: Milk? Well, the Groats family still have their permit, and I can't start stepping on their toes.

talking-to-the-duke.player: If you'd just try this milk...

talking-to-the-duke.speaker: Duke Horacio
talking-to-the-duke.text: I really couldn't possibly give you a permit without their approval. This is really their territory.

talking-to-the-duke.speaker: Duke Horacio
talking-to-the-duke.text: Why not speak to Gillie Groats? She seems to handle the milk side of the business now. Maybe she'll get you set up under their permit.

talking-to-the-duke.player: You're the Duke. Couldn't you just grant a permit?

talking-to-the-duke.speaker: Duke Horacio
talking-to-the-duke.text: No, no. It's really quite important you speak to Gillie about this.

talking-to-the-duke.player: Aren't you the highest power in this land?

talking-to-the-duke.speaker: Duke Horacio
talking-to-the-duke.text: Don't go digging too deeply into that. Even I have some... commitments that I have to keep to.

talking-to-the-duke.player: But you're the Duke, you shouldn't need the approval of a business entity to grant a permit.
Not to mention, can't they just refuse to have any competitors?

talking-to-the-duke.speaker: Duke Horacio
talking-to-the-duke.text: Well absolutely, but I'm sure you'll find they're more than reasonable about things.

talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-the-duke-.player: Hi, what did you want me to do for the permit again?

talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-the-duke-.speaker: Duke Horacio
talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-the-duke-.text: Go speak to Gillie Groats. She seems to handle the milk business in Lumbridge. Maybe she'll get you set up under their permit.

talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-gillie.speaker: Gillie Groats
talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-gillie.text: Hiya, did you need something else from me?

talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-gillie.player: I did. I've been trying to secure a business permit from the Duke, but he said that as it is a milk-related business venture, I should speak to you instead.

talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-gillie.speaker: Gillie Groats
talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-gillie.text: The Duke is a good man, directing you to me! I've been running the milk side of our farm for a while now.

talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-gillie.speaker: Gillie Groats
talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-gillie.text: Were you thinking of being a competitor to us then?
If the player doesn't have the second milk sample:

steps.player: I can prove we wouldn't be if you could just try this sample of...

steps.speaker: Gillie Groats
steps.text: Sample of?

steps.player: I seem to have misplaced my sample of milk. I'll be back when I have it.

talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-gillie.text: If the player has the second milk sample:

steps.player: I think if you were to try this sample here you'd see we wouldn't be competing.

steps.speaker: Gillie Groats
steps.text: You want me to drink a vial of mysterious liquid?

steps.player: Well, it's not mysterious, it's milk!

steps.speaker: Gillie Groats
steps.text: No, I think you should drink it, I'll know the quality of it from your reaction.

steps.speaker: Gillie Groats
steps.text: It is just milk after all.

steps.player: Would it convince you to help me with my permit?

steps.speaker: Gillie Groats
steps.text: It definitely won't hurt your chances.

talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-gillie-ag.speaker: Gillie Groats
talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-gillie-ag.text: Have you tried that milk sample yet?

talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-gillie-ag.player: Not yet. I really don't want to, but I guess I must.
I shouldn't drink this unless I have Gillie nearby.

talking-to-the-duke-drinking-the-second-.player: Oh, that's worse milk than before.

talking-to-the-duke-drinking-the-second-.speaker: Gillie Groats
talking-to-the-duke-drinking-the-second-.text: That looked like a horrible experience.

talking-to-the-duke-drinking-the-second-.speaker: Gillie Groats
talking-to-the-duke-drinking-the-second-.text: Where did you even get that milk?

talking-to-the-duke-drinking-the-second-.player: My business partner, Cassius. I don't know where he gets it from originally though.

talking-to-the-duke-drinking-the-second-.speaker: Gillie Groats
talking-to-the-duke-drinking-the-second-.text: Cassius... I don't recognise the name. He's not mentioned anything about its source?

talking-to-the-duke-drinking-the-second-.player: Nothing, but he apparently has enough of a source to start a business. I'm mostly trying to be helpful.
If the milk's bad, you're not going to recommend us for a permit, are you?

talking-to-the-duke-drinking-the-second-.speaker: Gillie Groats
talking-to-the-duke-drinking-the-second-.text: With how bad it looks, you wouldn't be any competition to us.

talking-to-the-duke-drinking-the-second-.speaker: Gillie Groats
talking-to-the-duke-drinking-the-second-.text: However, I wonder if I'd be doing a public service by protecting anyone else from it.

talking-to-the-duke-drinking-the-second-.player: Is there anything more I could do to convince you?

talking-to-the-duke-drinking-the-second-.speaker: Gillie Groats
talking-to-the-duke-drinking-the-second-.text: Now that you mention it, I've had an incredibly aggressive bull disrupting my herd lately. I've got him caught in the pen over there.

talking-to-the-duke-drinking-the-second-.speaker: Gillie Groats
talking-to-the-duke-drinking-the-second-.text: Perhaps you'd be interested in dealing with him? I'd owe you a fairly large favour.

talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-gillie-ag.speaker: Gillie Groats
talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-gillie-ag.text: How are you getting on with the bull?

talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-gillie-ag.player: I'm getting there! He looks quite tough though.

talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-cassius.speaker: Cassius
talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-cassius.text: Has the Duke given us our permit yet?

talking-to-the-duke-talking-to-cassius.player: It's become rather complicated, but I am working it out!

steps.text: The bull enters. The cows scatter.
The bull enters. The cows scatter.

facing-the-bull-after-killing-brutus.text: You notice a strange tag float to the ground as the bull falls. It reads 'Brutus'.
You notice a strange tag float to the ground as the bull falls. It reads 'Brutus'.

facing-the-bull-attempting-to-open-the-g.player: Brutus has already been dealt with.

facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie.speaker: Gillie Groats
facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie.text: You succeeded! I'll let the Duke know that you're all good to start a milk business.

facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie.player: I don't think that's going to be necessary anymore.

facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie.speaker: Gillie Groats
facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie.text: Oh? What happened in that field?

facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie.player: That bull was Cassius' other business partner, Brutus.
I'm sure he won't be feeling particularly friendly once I let him know.

facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie.speaker: Gillie Groats
facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie.text: That bull was one of the business partners?

facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie.speaker: Gillie Groats
facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie.text: I wonder if his aggression is why Cassius' herd are producing such bad milk...

facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie.player: I'm starting to think Cassius doesn't even have his own herd.

facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie.speaker: Gillie Groats
facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie.text: You think he's been stealing milk?

facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie.player: I'm not sure where else he would've been getting it from.

facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie.speaker: Gillie Groats
facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie.text: Why don't you go and talk to him about it! He may appreciate knowing the Brutus was bad for business.

facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie-again.speaker: Gillie Groats
facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie-again.text: Thank you once again for handling Brutus, he was causing quite a problem for my herd.

facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie-again.speaker: Gillie Groats
facing-the-bull-talking-to-gillie-again.text: And, if you haven't yet spoken to Cassius, you should probably let him know what's transpired.

facing-the-bull-returning-to-cassius.player: Cassius, I don't think we'll be getting our business permit.
So the Duke asked me to... and then Gillie said that...

facing-the-bull-returning-to-cassius.speaker: Cassius
facing-the-bull-returning-to-cassius.text: Don't tell me you killed Brutus and ruined my- our, plan?

facing-the-bull-returning-to-cassius.player: In my defence, I had no idea that was Brutus! You made it sound like he was a business partner.
Not to mention, apparently his aggression was ruining Seth's herd's milk. This should be a good thing!

facing-the-bull-returning-to-cassius.speaker: Cassius
facing-the-bull-returning-to-cassius.text: Ruining the milk? The unique flavour was what I was trying to sell!

facing-the-bull-returning-to-cassius.speaker: Cassius
facing-the-bull-returning-to-cassius.text: You should leave. I can't even look at you.

post-quest-talking-to-cassius.text: Cassius makes a point of ignoring you.

post-quest-talking-to-gillie.speaker: Gillie Groats
post-quest-talking-to-gillie.text: Oh, just the person I wanted to see! I have something for you.

post-quest-talking-to-gillie.speaker: Gillie Groats
post-quest-talking-to-gillie.text: This is for helping out with that bull. Our cows are much happier these days.
Gillie hands you an amulet with a bell on it.

post-quest-talking-to-gillie.speaker: Gillie Groats
post-quest-talking-to-gillie.text: One of our local milk enjoyers gave us some enchanted cow bells.

post-quest-talking-to-gillie.speaker: Gillie Groats
post-quest-talking-to-gillie.text: They seem to be quite versatile, enjoy!

post-quest-talking-to-gillie.player: Wow, thank you! I'll make sure to check it out.

steps.speaker: Gillie Groats
steps.text: I also have something else for you but your inventory is full. Can you make some room?

steps.speaker: Gillie Groats
steps.text: I also have this for you!
Gillie hands you a magical lamp.

steps.player: Oh, thank you!

post-quest-talking-to-gillie-again-if-th.text: Gillie hands you a magical lamp.

post-quest-talking-to-gillie-without-a-c.player: I've lost that amulet you gave me...

post-quest-talking-to-gillie-without-a-c.text: Gillie hands you an amulet with a bell on it.

sN9QkN.speaker: Gillie Groats
sN9QkN.text: Ah, your inventory is full. Can you make some room?
